SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) DESC, DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE() ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
